passive.name: Dispossession
passive.text: The wearer's base SPD increases by **12/14/16/18/20**. When dealing DMG, ignores **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by **60/78/96/114/132%**.

passive.name: Deeply Engrossed
passive.text: Greatly increases the wearer's chance of getting attacked and increases CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. After the wearer uses Ultimate, receives 1 stack of "Firedance," lasting for 2 turns and stacking up to **2** time(s). Each stack of "Firedance" increases the DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATK by **36/42/48/54/60%**.

passive.name: Kinship
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **24/28/32/36/40%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy or is hit, immediately restores HP equal to **8/9/10/11/12%** of the wearer's ATK. At the same time, the wearer's DMG is increased by **24/28/32/36/40%** until the end of their next turn. This effect cannot stack and can only trigger 1 time per turn.

passive.name: Unfulfilled Yearning
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%** and increases their Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer is attacked or consumes their own HP, their DMG increases by **24/28/32/36/40%**. This effect is removed after the wearer uses an attack.

weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint if desired) = CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: I Want to Help
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of Clara's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Svarog Watches Over You
entries.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to **120%** of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to **120%** of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter.
All Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used.

entries.name: Promise, Not Command
entries.text:
After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra **25%**, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for **2** turn(s).
In addition, Svarog's Counter is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a Counter, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by **160%**. Enemies adjacent to it take 50% of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy. Enhanced Counter(s) can take effect **2** time(s).

entries.name: Because We're Family
entries.text: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by **10%**. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a Counter, dealing Physical DMG equal to **160%** of Clara's ATK.

entries.name: A Small Price for Victory
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Kinship
entries.text: When attacked, this unit has a **35%** fixed chance to dispel 1 debuff placed on them.

entries.name: Under Protection
entries.text: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by **35%**.

entries.name: Revenge
entries.text: Increases DMG dealt by Svarog's Counter by **30%**.

entries.name: A Tall Figure
entries.text: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy.

entries.name: A Tight Embrace
entries.text: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by 30% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Cold Steel Armor
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Family's Warmth
entries.text: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by 30%. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: A Small Promise
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Long Company
entries.text: After other allies are attacked, Svarog also has a 50% fixed chance to trigger a Counter on the attacker and mark them with a "Mark of Counter." When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by 1.
